questionEn: Which formulation more accurately distinguishes “hydrogen (Hydrogenium)” from similar ideas?
questionUz: Qaysi formula "vodorod (Hydrogenium)" ni o'xshash g'oyalardan aniqroq ajratib turadi?
choicesEn: a chemical element in the periodic table represented by the symbol H and an atomic number of 1
A complex substance that forms H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ions in an aqueous solution
choicesUz: davriy jadvaldagi H belgisi va atom raqami 1 bilan ifodalangan kimyoviy element
Suvli eritmada H⁺ (H₃O⁺) ionlarini hosil qiluvchi murakkab modda.
explanationEn: Hydrogen (Hydrogenium) is a chemical element in the periodic table, represented by the symbol H and atomic number 1.
explanationUz: Vodorod (Hydrogenium) davriy jadvaldagi kimyoviy element bo'lib, H belgisi va atom raqami 1 bilan ifodalanadi.
